front.title: Detecting AI-Driven Subscriber Advantage in Media over QUIC (MOQ)

abstract.t: This document describes subscriber behavior that may produce sustained advantages in service outcomes or disproportionate resource consumption at shared Media over QUIC (MoQ) relays. AI-assisted optimization is a motivating scenario; observations alone cannot establish whether AI was used or caused a disparity. The document outlines contextual measurement, privacy safeguards, and a proposed extension for authorization-bound resource budgets with explicit accounting and recovery behavior. It builds on existing MoQ authorization and relay denial-of-service work. This informational document defines no new MoQ messages, token claims, registries, or standardized detection algorithm.
